title: Length of the embedded gate list
statement: Let $D$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m$ input vertices, let $srcs$ be a list of natural numbers, and let $L$ be a natural number. The gate list formed by embedding $D$ using $srcs$ and $L$ has length equal to the number of gates of $D$ plus one.
hypotheses_covered: A directed acyclic circuit $D$ with $m$ input vertices
